note: The reader's timelines. A visit moment is worked out on every page load from the stored record (p2s.lens), the clock and the URL, before first paint. reference/line-engine.js momentFrom() implements this order exactly; the first match wins.

detectionOrder.when: URL has ?as= and it differs from the saved role (or nothing is saved and the reader has not kept it)
URL or session has an as-of date in the past
the role, reader or depth changed in the last few seconds (set by the control, not by a load)
a new build was published while this page is open, with at least one change for the role
not confirmed and this is visit 1: the question stays on every page of the first visit (open size on inner pages)
not confirmed and this is visit 2 (askAtMost): asked once more, on every page of that visit; never after
more than catchUpChanges changes for the role, or at least one change and away catchUpDays or more
at least one change for the role since the visit started counting (visitStart().since); stays until Show me / Mark as seen
the same visit (active in the last sessionGapMinutes), nothing new
a new visit within sameVisitMinutes of the last activity, nothing new
a new visit, nothing new for the role, last activity was today
anything else: the page's one line

first.label: First visit
first.size: panel on the front page, open elsewhere
first.writes: persona, source, confirmed=false, asked=1, firstVisit, lastVisit, visits=1

second.label: Second visit, never answered
second.writes: asked+1; after askAtMost the view is kept quietly

week.label: Back within a week
week.writes: nothing until Show me / Mark as seen; lastVisit moves on when the visit ends

long.label: Back after a week or more
long.writes: as week; catch-up marks the five as seen

visitEnds: A gap of sessionGapMinutes without activity starts a new visit. Then, and only then, lastVisit is set to the previous lastActive and visits goes up by one; so a reload never wipes 'since you were last here'. Show me, Mark as seen and Catch me up set lastVisit to now. Use visitStart() to know whether a load starts a visit and from when to count changes.
